description: Resume a saved review using its private author capability after the previous MCP owner disconnects. A live owner cannot be displaced. Restored in-progress work is interrupted; declare new work explicitly. Completed reviews remain read-only and can be reopened for viewing. This connection supplies its actual MCP identity; optional agent labels are caller-declared, as when opening a review. Omit agent to use only the new connection identity. Completed artifacts keep their final author unchanged. A new relay may return a new liveUrl.

agent.description: Optional caller-declared display identity for the resumed author; preserves actual MCP client name, version, and connection ID

harness.description: Caller-declared harness label, for example Codex; not inferred or verified by Arc

name: resume_architecture_review
